shared_elements: profile heads or creatures with elongated snouts/beaks
justification: The main overlap is only broad: both use schematic outline conventions to depict animal-like forms, elongated profile heads, circular/eye-like marks, and some repeated linear ornament. The biggest difference is that A is a single frontal anthropomorphic figure holding staffs and wearing elaborate appendages/regalia, whereas B is a multi-register field of separate profile animals and signs with no comparable central staff-bearing figure or compositional scheme.
